annotations.title: What a Wallet pass can do

description: Answers what an Apple or Google Wallet pass can do, from the Sonar Connections pass catalog: every option Apple and Google offer a pass issuer. Use it for questions like "what can my pass do", "what can go on the front of my pass", "can links sit on the front of the pass", "I want a loyalty program", "a coupon that expires", "tickets I can subtract at a food festival" or "can I put a sponsor on the pass". Pass the person's words as `question`; `wallet`, `passType`, `area` and `status` narrow the rows. The reply lists at most 8 rows, front first, then says how many more match and which filter narrows them. Each row says what it is, what the holder sees, which wallets and pass types carry it, where it sits, and one status sentence for Sonar Connections today; read that sentence as given, including "not yet". With `eventIdOrName`, a person who may change that event's details hears which rows their event's pass carries; anyone else hears a general answer. It reads only: it changes no pass, draws no preview and promises no date.

area.description: Optional: where it sits: front, back, details, list, lock screen or notification.

eventIdOrName.description: Optional: the event id or name, to hear which rows its pass carries.

passType.description: Optional: a pass type, for example eventTicket, generic, storeCard, coupon, loyalty, offer or giftCard.

question.description: The person's question, in their words.

status.description: Optional: settable, built, not built, needs approval or cannot.
